mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-01.title: Areas scale by the square
mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-01.body:
Lengths scale by $\frac54$, so areas scale by $\frac{25}{16}$. The three areas are $270$, $270 \cdot \frac{25}{16}$, $270 \cdot \left(\frac{25}{16}\right)^2$:
$$270\left(1 + \frac{25}{16} + \frac{625}{256}\right) = 270 \cdot \frac{256 + 400 + 625}{256} = 270 \cdot \frac{1281}{256} = \frac{345870}{256} = \frac{172935}{128} = 1351\frac{7}{128}.$$

**Answer: $1351\frac{7}{128}$ square feet**

mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-02.title: Room by room
mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-02.body:
3rd room: $\frac{375}{16} = 23\frac7{16}$ ft by $\frac{225}{8} = 28\frac18$ ft (scale factor $\frac54$).
Wall area $= 10 \times$ perimeter:
- 1st: $10 \cdot 2(15 + 18) = 660$
- 2nd: $10 \cdot 2(18\frac34 + 22\frac12) = 825$
- 3rd: $10 \cdot 2(23\frac7{16} + 28\frac18) = 1031\frac14$

Door + window per room: $6\frac34 \cdot 3\frac12 + 5 \cdot 11\frac12 = 23\frac58 + 57\frac12 = 81\frac18$.
Paint: $(660 + 825 + 1031\frac14) - 3 \cdot 81\frac18 = 2516\frac14 - 243\frac38 = 2272\frac78$ ft².

**Answer: $2272\frac{7}{8}$ square feet**

mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-02.title: Perimeters scale too
mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-02.body:
Perimeters scale by $\frac54$: $66$, $82.5$, $103.125$ ft, total $251.625$ ft. Wall area $= 2516.25$ ft². Openings: $3 \times 81.125 = 243.375$ ft². Paint: $2516.25 - 243.375 = 2272.875 = 2272\frac78$ ft².

**Answer: $2272\frac{7}{8}$ square feet**

mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-03.title: Tile days + paint days
mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-03.body:
Floor area (scale factor $\frac54$ per room): $270 + 421\frac78 + 659\frac{23}{128} = 1351\frac7{128}$ ft². Wall area to paint: $2272\frac78$ ft² (walls $10 \times$ perimeter, minus $81\frac18$ ft² of door and window per room).
Tile: $1351.05 \div 225 \approx 6.005$ days. Paint: $2272.875 \div 750 \approx 3.031$ days. Total $\approx 9.04 \approx 9$ days.

**Answer: 9 days**

mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-03.title: Estimate
mathcounts-potw-2026-09-07-03.body:
Floor area $\approx 1351$ ft² is almost exactly $6 \times 225 = 1350$; wall area $\approx 2273$ ft² is about $3 \times 750 = 2250$. So about $6 + 3 = 9$ days (precisely 9.04).

**Answer: 9 days**
